- Keep a sticky note on the fridge: “Lunch + Form + Backpack.” Check it once before leaving.

- Set a 3-minute timer. Scan only what’s urgent (kid’s meds/temp, tomorrow’s schedule). When timer ends, stop.

- Dim lights, sit comfortably, and listen to a calming podcast/ambient sounds on low volume with headphones. Focus only on the sound until your mind settles.
